author: Fixture Reporter
content: Nvidia Corp. shares reached a record high on Friday following board approval for an additional $150 billion in share repurchase authorization. This new program increases Nvidia's remaining buyback capacity to approximately $235 billion through fiscal 2028. Analysts estimate that the buyback could reduce the share count by about 4.2% and boost earnings per share by roughly 1.6% by 2028. Nvidia stock climbed roughly 2% to $235.50 at midday after reaching a record intraday high of $237.55, pushing its market capitalization to approximately $5.7 trillion. Since the beginning of the year, Nvidia stock has gained 25%.
headline: Nvidia Shares Climb to Record Peaks as Board Approves Massive $150 Billion Repurchase Program
summary: Nvidia shares hit all-time highs after authorizing a $150 billion buyback, pushing total capacity to $235 billion through fiscal 2028.
